title: Aspen Search testimonial slider
description: One long quote at a time in large tight type on a hairline grid, with the speaker's name and mono role at its foot, a portrait frame, an ink tile of facts (position, company) and a halftone window. A thin ink bar fills across two square arrow buttons and moves on to the next quote by itself; each quote rises in and its lines reveal as they scroll into view.
notes: needs JavaScript for the slides; the progress bar is a CSS animation that pauses on hover
photo per quote and the desktop window are media slots; empty, grey frame and halftone placeholder
name: aspensearch-testimonials

props.name: items
props.description: the quotes, shown one at a time

props.name: interval
props.description: seconds each quote stays before the next one (the bar fills meanwhile)

props.name: media
props.description: media for the window under the facts tile (desktop); empty: halftone placeholder
